name: Acrobat
flavor_rewritten: A career spent on ropes and ledges pays out in steady footing: tighter dodges, calmer trap steps, and a rope that finds a way up once a floor.

name: Criminal
flavor_rewritten: Pickpockets and padlocks are an old language. The criminal reads both fluently and argues prices like a con artist.

name: Guild Artisan
flavor_rewritten: Guild marks open doors to better terms: gear holds together longer, sales bring more coin, and the hub workbench owes a favor.

name: Noble
flavor_rewritten: Old money, older expectations. The noble starts richer and talks past merchants, but the silver signet marks them as fair prey for price-gougers.

name: Outlander
flavor_rewritten: Raised where the road ends, the outlander tastes poison and calls it weather, and always packs enough salt meat to patch up after a floor's first camp.

name: Sage
flavor_rewritten: Twelve years of libraries condense into one extra spark behind every spell, plus a scroll case that promises one surprise per descent.
